text.en:
Adjustment of Dividend Rate. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No.
7656, the percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the LBP to the
National Government for CY 2022 is adjusted from fifty percent (50%) of its annual net
earnings to zero percent (0%).
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Coverage. The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this
Order is applicable only to the LBP for CY 2022.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 11th
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.
day of October
By the President:
Executive Satretary
Office of the President
MALACANANG RECORDS OFFICE
